Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.2:

- Product Lifecycle now includes two new Software pages: Forcepoint DSPM and Forcepoint Data Classification (FDC). Each supports the same Version / GA / End of Sale / End of Maintenance / End of Support tracking, inline editing, reordering, and JSON/HTML import as the other product lines.
- The new pages start empty so you can populate them with the relevant version lifecycle data; existing installs render them safely without affecting other catalogue data.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
